title: Governance 2.1.0 control-plane promotion
objective: Settle Governance 2.1.0, Control Plane Profile 0.3.0, selected-future closure, bounded-caller contracts, and bot-bound dependency automation into one reviewable release.

work_items.desired_state: Governance schema release 2.1.0 expresses bounded callers, Practitioner Probes, veracity, orientation, probabilities, and selected-future closure.
entry_evidence: Enterprise Human-AI Practitioner Registry assessment and approved implementation plan.
completion_evidence: Every schema and mapped example passes the governance validator.
The selected-future closure contract represents all four substantive receipt families.

work_items.desired_state: Dependabot and Renovate exceptions combine complete branch grammar, exact pull-request author, governed target, and the ordinary validation path.
entry_evidence: Live Dependabot pull requests exposed the GitFlow branch-policy mismatch and stale label assumptions.
Official GitHub behavior identifies read-only tokens, Dependabot-scoped secrets, and default-branch security updates.
completion_evidence: Spoof, malformed-coordinate, wrong-target, partial-coordinate, Dependabot, and Renovate regression tests pass.
The repository-local branch checker binds complete branch grammar, exact bot author, and governed target together.
Dependency configuration and admitted ecosystem grammar advance together.

work_items.desired_state: The governance release identifies its annotated tag object, accepted commit, reproducible archive digest, schema release, and downstream adoption path.
entry_evidence: All repository-local governance and automation checks pass.
completion_evidence: A governed release branch targets main and becomes an accepted, signed, annotated release tag.
A later evidence commit records the tag object, accepted commit, archive digest, and their ancestry relationship.
The Machine Node replaces candidate zeros with the accepted commit and archive digest.
Downstream adoption guidance names the promoted schema and workflow coordinates.

reentry_capsule.current_state: Governance 2.1.0 is accepted and its tag, source commit, and reproducible archive digest are recorded; downstream adoption and Pages publication are ready for their receivers.
reentry_capsule.next_safe_action: Pin Governance 2.1.0 in downstream repositories and publish the accepted deterministic retrieval artifact.
reentry_capsule.verification: Confirm the exact tag, accepted commit, reproducible archive digest, 2.1.0 schema conformance, and retrieval-artifact manifest before downstream use.

retained_effects: Simulation closure remains definitive only within its selected future reality.
Automation identity requires both branch grammar and exact pull-request author.
Ordinary validation and accountable review continue for automated maintenance.
consequential_questions: Which downstream repository should adopt the accepted tag, commit, and archive digest next?
Which future automation caller provides enough value to justify a new explicit grammar and author binding?
